announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Steadily on course following repayment of all promissory notes due in 2026
announcements.insight: Following July restructuring agreements, all 2026 promissory notes have been repaid. This resolves financial liabilities and reduces refinancing risk for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: GreenBiz Park Erding fully let
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG confirms GreenBiz Park Erding is fully let, following the July letting of additional space. This completes the leasing cycle for this asset.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Successful renewal of lease with existing tenant at the Ludwigshafen Technology Park
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG successfully renewed a lease at Ludwigshafen Technology Park. This follows earlier leasing activity in Ingolstadt and Erding during June and July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: VIB Vermögen AG: Lock-Up Agreements with noteholders and promissory noteholders of BRANICKS Group AG have become fully effective
announcements.insight: Following the July restructuring agreements, lock-up provisions for BRANICKS Group AG noteholders are now effective, confirming progress in the debt resolution process.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: VIB Vermögen AG: Agreements on the restructuring of financial liabilities of BRANICKS Group AG signed, incl. commitment for a € 60 mn financing for VIB Vermögen AG
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG secures €60mn financing to support BRANICKS Group restructuring. This follows recent joint venture and leasing activity, indicating strategic capital deployment.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: A further 23,100 sqm let at GreenBiz Park in Erding
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG secured further lettings at GreenBiz Park in Erding. This follows earlier lease extensions and reletting activity across its portfolio.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Successful re-letting of a logistics centre in Den Hoorn, the Netherlands
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG re-let a logistics centre in Den Hoorn. This follows earlier lease extensions and joint venture announcements, indicating ongoing asset management.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Early extension of lease agreement with AUMOVIO in Ingolstadt
announcements.insight: VIB Vermögen AG extended a lease agreement with AUMOVIO. This follows its June joint venture announcement with Tristan Capital Partners.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: VIB Vermögen AG: Joint Venture with a fund managed by Tristan Capital Partners for the development of logistics real estate
announcements.insight: VIB Vermoegen AG N (0AC3) has entered a joint venture for logistics real estate development. Shareholders should monitor future filings for details on financial terms and project progress.
